items.title: Should You Buy Reddit Stock Because Its Renewal Risk Is Already Priced In?
items.summary: Reddit (RDDT) stock closed 9.3% higher on Wednesday at $158.10, and the news behind it came from a research desk rather than from Reddit. The argument was that the worst outcome for two of its data licensing contracts is already in the price. That put a price on the cheaper half of Reddit's AI question. The expensive half is untouched.
